title: Model 2 midpoint of current and wind physics: pre-registered drifter test
scope: Parameter-free 50:50 midpoint of the current-coupled and wind-only 2 percent forecasts, scored on archived undrogued surface drifters. Drifters are an analogue, not Sargassum.
summary: Registered before any drifter was scored, the midpoint beat both comparators at 24, 48 and 72 h. Paired median endpoint difference versus current plus 2% wind: -2.29 km (24 h, 1,565 cases, 46 drifters), -4.88 km (48 h, 1,405 cases, 45 drifters), -6.76 km (72 h, 1,249 cases, 42 drifters), all with whole-drifter 95% intervals excluding zero. Median errors were 13.8, 25.8 and 36.0 km versus 16.2, 29.8 and 41.2 km. On Sargassum GPS tracks the same line of work was not confirmed.

limitations: The source report is an untracked working-tree file; it is identified by SHA-256 only and has no source commit.
Drifters are undrogued surface drifters, not floating Sargassum; mats move somewhat differently, and Sargassum GPS looks were NOT_CONFIRMED.
Forcing is archived analysis fields standing in for forecasts.
The same drifter product was used earlier in development of related arms; the midpoint itself was registered before scoring.
The run was stopped at 6,400 of 6,514 cases and resumed with the script resume path, completing all 6,514.
